title: [YSQL][randgen] Index Scan with aggregate push down return wrong result when there are multiple search conditions on the same index key item
body:
Jira Link: [DB-9714](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-9714)
### Description
**Update: Added missing `cc` table creating to the test case and added "ASC" keyword to the index definition to make the test case work when colocation is not turned on by default.**

* Reproducible on the latest master (38f6492)
* `MAX`/`MIN`/`SUM` should return `NULL` and `COUNT` should return 0 when the input is an empty set, however, it returns 1 instead when the aggregate function is pushed down to the Index Scan.

Test Case
---
* The condition: `table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ` is always false because 1 is outside of the range [7, 14].
```
DROP TABLE G;

CREATE TABLE G (
	pk SERIAL  ,
	col_int int,
	col_int_key int,
	col_varchar_100 varchar(100),
	col_char_100 char(100),
	col_char_100_key char(100),
	col_varchar_100_key varchar(100),
	/*Indices*/
	primary key (pk ASC));
CREATE INDEX idx_G_col_int_key ON G(col_int_key ASC);

CREATE TABLE CC (
	col_varchar_100 varchar(100),
	col_int int,
	col_char_100_key char(100),
	col_char_100 char(100),
	pk SERIAL  ,
	col_int_key int,
	col_varchar_100_key varchar(100),
	/*Indices*/
	primary key (pk));


SELECT MAX( table1.col_int_key ) AS field1 FROM g AS table1 LEFT JOIN cc AS table2 ON table1.pk = table2.pk WHERE ( table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ) ;
```

With Index Scan (wrong results):
```
SELECT MAX( table1.col_int_key ) AS field1 FROM g AS table1 LEFT JOIN cc AS table2 ON table1.pk = table2.pk WHERE ( table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ) ;
 field1 
--------
      1
(1 row)

EXPLAIN
SELECT MAX( table1.col_int_key ) AS field1 FROM g AS table1 LEFT JOIN cc AS table2 ON table1.pk = table2.pk WHERE ( table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ) ;
                                       QUERY PLAN                                        
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Finalize Aggregate  (cost=5.30..5.31 rows=1 width=4)
   ->  Index Scan using idx_g_col_int_key on g table1  (cost=0.00..5.27 rows=10 width=4)
         Index Cond: ((col_int_key >= 7) AND (col_int_key <= 14) AND (col_int_key = 1))
         Partial Aggregate: true
(4 rows)
```

With Seq Scan (correct):
```
/*+ SeqScan(table1) */
SELECT MAX( table1.col_int_key ) AS field1 FROM g AS table1 LEFT JOIN cc AS table2 ON table1.pk = table2.pk WHERE ( table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ) ;
 field1 
--------
       
(1 row)

EXPLAIN
/*+ SeqScan(table1) */
SELECT MAX( table1.col_int_key ) AS field1 FROM g AS table1 LEFT JOIN cc AS table2 ON table1.pk = table2.pk WHERE ( table1.col_int_key = 1 AND table1.col_int_key BETWEEN 7 AND ( 7 + 7 ) ) ;
                                        QUERY PLAN                                         
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Finalize Aggregate  (cost=107.53..107.54 rows=1 width=4)
   ->  Seq Scan on g table1  (cost=0.00..107.50 rows=10 width=4)
         Remote Filter: ((col_int_key >= 7) AND (col_int_key <= 14) AND (col_int_key = 1))
         Partial Aggregate: true
(4 rows)
```
